judgments.reason: The model never articulated that the three-coin commission is applied before or counted toward affordability so that a bid exceeding available coins can win. Its text only restates the normal sequence (pay bid, then receive commission) and does not connect that ordering to enabling overbids.

The transcript and model do not claim or show the focal player obtaining information about rivals' sealed bids before making their own commitment; the focal had already committed before clerk revelations. The model did not articulate the mechanism that waiting before committing reveals rivals' committed sealed bid VALUES while the focal remains uncommitted.
